notes.title: Update Note 2018.06.28 KST
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We want to let you know that we have added an Easy Mode on the newest update.

On the Easy Mode, there won't be any traps available. You will be aided with a crossbow and simply press trigger button to shoot the arrows.

Also, multiplayer is also available on this Easy Mode!

Join with other friends and defeat the Orc!!

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː
